en.title: Saudi-Israel Recognition Hopes Rise
en.summary: The probability of Saudi Arabia recognizing Israel by year-end rose to 10%, driven by reports of increased intelligence cooperation against Houthi threats. This shift comes as Saudi Arabia faces growing security challenges and potential US disengagement.
drivers: Israel provides intelligence aid to Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks.
Saudi Arabia faces Houthi threats, US less involved.
Saudi Arabia postponed Tehran-GCC meeting, signaling cooling Iran ties.
en.why_matters: Recognition would fundamentally reshape Middle East geopolitics, creating a powerful anti-Iran bloc and potentially stabilizing the region. It could also unlock significant economic opportunities.
en.bull_case: Continued Houthi attacks and increased Israeli security assistance will compel Saudi Arabia to formalize ties for shared defense.
en.bear_case: Escalation of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict or internal Saudi political resistance would make recognition politically unfeasible.

zh.title: 沙特以色列建交概率上升
zh.summary: 沙特阿拉伯在年底前承认以色列的概率升至10%，主要驱动因素是两国在应对胡塞武装威胁方面的情报合作增加。沙特面临日益严峻的安全挑战和美国潜在的脱离，促使这一转变。
drivers: 以色列向沙特提供情报援助，应对胡塞武装袭击。
沙特面临胡塞威胁，美国介入减少。
沙特推迟与伊朗会议，暗示伊沙关系降温。
zh.why_matters: 承认将重塑中东地缘政治格局，形成强大的反伊朗联盟，并可能稳定地区局势。它还可能带来巨大的经济机遇。
zh.bull_case: 胡塞武装持续袭击及以色列安全援助增加，将促使沙特为共同防御正式建交。
zh.bear_case: 以巴冲突升级或沙特国内政治阻力，将使承认以色列在政治上不可行。
